# Theorem Certificate Ledger

The TheoremForces ledger records reproducibility metadata for Lean build artifacts. It does not replace mathlib, does not certify informal mathematical exposition, and does not provide official Lean or mathlib endorsement.

The ledger exposes existing v1 verification records called theorem certificates. Production issuance of legacy v1 certificates is disabled; a new Accepted result does not imply that a new certificate was issued. Existing v1 certificates are content-addressed by SHA-256, retained while the platform and its archives remain available, and can be cited through the Ledger imports system (see Importing certified theorems).

## Release boundary: historical v1 and the current L1 specification

A v1 Accepted record says that the exact generated artifact passed the configured judge and axiom checks in the recorded, pinned Lean/Mathlib environment at that time. It does not assert present-day rebuildability, independent-checker agreement, peer review, or inclusion in an independently verifiable append-only log.
